title: Trump expected to name Jay Clayton as AI czar
key_facts: CNN, citing two sources familiar with the discussion, reports that President Trump is expected to pick Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence, as the White House's AI czar.
One source said the announcement could come as early as Friday (2 Oct 2026); NBC's source said it would most likely be on social media.
Clayton is expected to keep his director of national intelligence job while taking on the AI role.
A White House official said any personnel announcement will come directly from the President and that reporting until then is 'baseless speculation'.
Trump said on Tuesday he was 'very close to making a decision' and would name one over the next three or four days, after checking with 'the companies' and House Republican leaders.
Earlier coverage (Axios, 30 Sep 2026) said Trump had floated Clayton for the job; CBS first reported Clayton as the frontrunner.
David Sacks was AI and crypto czar until March 2026 and now co-chairs the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology.
Trump has so far favoured AI companies 'self-policing' over stronger safety rules after a Tuesday White House meeting with tech executives.
quote_evidence: President Donald Trump is expected to pick Jay Clayton to be the White House's new czar of artificial intelligence, two sources familiar with the discussion told CNN.
A White House official told CNN, "Any personnel announcement will be announced directly by the President. Any reporting until then is baseless speculation."

Clayton, who previously served as the top federal prosecutor in Manhattan and led the Securities and Exchange Commission during the majority of Trump's first term, is expected to remain in his role as director of national intelligence, the sources said.
why_it_matters_hint: The White House is expected to put the director of national intelligence in charge of AI, a role vacant since Sacks left in March.
event_date: 2 Oct 2026 (reports); no announcement seen as of late 2 Oct 2026
notes: Reuters original (which cites CNN) returned HTTP 401. Read CNN and NBC News reports. Follow-up of the 30 Sep 2026 Axios item 'Trump floats Jay Clayton as AI czar' (1 Oct pool, C13-10). No official announcement found in the latest headlines (WaPo, KHGI about 23:30 UTC 2 Oct still say 'expected').
